name: Secondary Education
summary: Secondary Education prepares students to teach middle and high school students in a specific subject. Students combine study in their teaching subject with education courses and student teaching.
description: Secondary Education majors choose a subject area such as English, math, science, social studies, or a world language and complete coursework in that discipline along with education courses. Education coursework covers adolescent development, subject-specific teaching methods, classroom management, assessment, literacy across the curriculum, and teaching students with diverse needs. Field placements in middle and high schools lead to a semester of student teaching. Graduates earn state licensure to teach grades 6-12 or 7-12 and work in public and private schools.
